summary: Customer-owned recommendation decisions exposed through the canonical Subject Home boundary: one owner/admin-checked server action writes exactly one authoritative decisions-ledger call; the read model projects the latest durable decision. accepted/rejected are fully operable; modified is explicitly unsupported by the existing schema and must NOT be fabricated.

object.targetLinkage: record_decision validates recommendation -> intelligence_run -> subject (kernel-owned); product layer pre-checks the same linkage and fails closed with zero writes

decisionLedger.unsupportedReason: decisions.decision CHECK constraint (kernel migration 20260723020611_alm_intelligence_kernel.sql) admits only accepted/rejected/superseded. recommendation_outcomes admits accepted/rejected/modified but requires a bounded observation window (window_start/window_end) and is the outcomes ledger for efficacy observation, NOT the decision ledger; using it as a substitute decision ledger without an observation window is prohibited.
decisionLedger.supersededHandling: superseded remains honest in the projection (display state decided_other); never mapped to accepted/free/success.

writeSemantics.validSubmission: exactly one allowlisted record_decision RPC call
writeSemantics.duplicate: zero writes; idempotent ok with the existing decision id
writeSemantics.unsupported: zero writes; modified returns an explicit partial message, never success
writeSemantics.unauthorized: zero writes; opaque 'Recommendation not found.' (no existence leak)
writeSemantics.wrongSubject: zero writes; product pre-check plus kernel RPC backstop
writeSemantics.persistenceFailure: exactly one attempted write surfaced as an error, never success

projection.latestDecision: decisions rows ordered by created_at desc, then id desc; first row per target wins (deterministic regardless of query order)
projection.rejectedSuppression: a recommendation whose latest durable decision is rejected is suppressed from actionable surfaces (Overview active list and Recommendations tab) until a NEW recommendation row with new evidence/run exists; rejection recurrence is tied to the durable decision
projection.clientState: client mirrors a decision ONLY after the server action confirms the write; the decisions ledger remains the authoritative source and the read model re-projects on every load

experience.controls: Accept/Reject buttons rendered only for proposed recommendations with no durable decision
experience.loading: both controls disabled while a decision is pending; spinner on the active control
experience.errorRecovery: bounded role=alert error; cleared on the next attempt
experience.accessibility: native button elements with text labels and aria-labels
experience.targetSize: size=lg (h-11 = 44px) decision controls in a flex-wrap container for the 390px composition

missingAuthority.owner: kernel migrations (supabase/migrations/) and generated Supabase types (web/src/lib/supabase/types.ts)
missingAuthority.change: add 'modified' to the decisions.decision CHECK constraint via an additive kernel-owned migration, refresh generated types, then re-open the product surface
missingAuthority.correctionPath: kernel-owned ALM card; the product adapter already routes through the one-call path and would enable modified without a second store
